about: Rule data shared by the ledger (src/latent.mjs, Node) and the latent runtime (runtime/latent_pool, Python). Both read this file, so a rule changes in one place. rules/latent-conformance.json holds the cases both test suites run against each side's logic. Contract: docs/latent-read.md.

secretPaths.about: A path is secret when any segment before the last is one of dirs, or when its last segment (lower-cased) is not one of templates and is one of names, starts with one of prefixes or ends with one of suffixes. Comparisons are on lower-cased segments.

quoteWhitespace.about: The code points folded into one space when a quote is compared with file lines: exactly what JavaScript's \s matches with the u flag (normalizeSpace in src/latent.mjs, fold_space in runtime/latent_pool/pool.py). Each entry is one hex code point or an inclusive hex range. tests/latent-rules.test.mjs pins this list to /\s/u.
